title: Experiment: Confirmed Component V2 Safety & Integrity
description: Blinded-safe operational board for the OFF-gated confirmed-component experiment lane. No comparative efficacy or X/Y mapping is exposed.

options.content: This board shows lifecycle, work, derived cfg-readback equality, exposure, generations, fallback, outcome completeness, and rollback readiness. Future randomized work/assignment identity is database-clock masked. It intentionally omits the randomization secret, X/Y mapping, physical-arm resolution, and comparative efficacy. Any red state requires the rollout runbook's close/recover/yield action before advance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::integer AS "Actionable" FROM public.fn_experiment_v2_ops_status() WHERE alert_severity IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Lifecycle, authority, and current typed work

targets.rawSql: SELECT experiment_id AS "Experiment", lifecycle_status AS "Lifecycle", execution_phase AS "Phase", admission_state AS "Admission", component_enabled AS "Capability", lease_generation AS "Lease gen", operation_kind AS "Operation", work_id AS "Work", assignment_id AS "Assignment", future_randomized_identity_masked AS "Future masked", safety_state AS "Safety", fallback_state AS "Fallback" FROM public.fn_experiment_v2_ops_status() ORDER BY experiment_id

panels.title: Derived readback, exposure, and writer truth

targets.rawSql: SELECT experiment_id AS "Experiment", expected_observed_equal AS "Expected = observed", observation_truth AS "Observation truth", observation_evidence_count AS "Receipts", observation_age_seconds AS "Age s", open_exposure_count AS "Open exposures", writer_generation AS "Writer gen", connection_generation AS "Connection gen", expected_state_content_sha256 AS "Expected state hash", observed_state_content_sha256 AS "Observed state hash" FROM public.fn_experiment_v2_ops_status() ORDER BY experiment_id

SELECT experiment_id AS "Experiment", frozen_outcome_count AS "Frozen outcomes", expected_outcome_count AS "Expected outcomes", outcomes_complete AS "Complete", rollback_ready AS "Rollback ready" FROM public.fn_experiment_v2_ops_status() ORDER BY experiment_id

SELECT experiment_id AS "Experiment", alert_severity AS "Severity", alert_reason AS "Reason", safety_state AS "Safety", admission_state AS "Admission", resolved_at AS "Evaluated at" FROM public.fn_experiment_v2_ops_status() WHERE alert_severity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE alert_severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, experiment_id
